verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents accepting payments in more than thirty currencies through local methods such as M-Pesa, ACH for USD/ZAR, and OPay, plus an API to query FX rates and execute trades. That covers local-currency charging and some rate visibility. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic settlement to the merchant's bank in their own currency or how conversion fees and rates are disclosed on settled charges. missing for 10: documented settlement-currency selection and conversion to the founder's bank, transparent FX fee/markup disclosure on collections, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: We accept payments in more than thirty currencies.
Query rates and execute FX trades.
Collect ACH payments for USD and ZAR transactions.
Collect Mpesa payments from customers in Kenya.
